summary: Agent usage summaries include selected rollup costs only when all contributing costs are known and use one currency.

replay.detail: Usage readers include selected rollup costs and require complete single-currency costs. Claim replay and arrangement rebuild behavior stay unchanged.

schema.detail: No persisted tables, indexes or projection layouts change.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules change from 15 to 16 and include the usage-reader cost contract in the rules digest. The existing arrangement proof and replay identity are retained. Mixed rules digests cannot seal a new shared checkpoint.

compatibility.detail: UsageSummary.aggregation is now rollup-per-slot-else-cumulative-per-incarnation-else-response-deltas. Older clients cannot decode this new literal. All in-repo apps and the daemon move in one deploy; do not mix older apps with the new daemon.

downtime.detail: Restart-to-API and restart-to-health times have not been measured for this change.

manual.detail: Deploy the apps and daemon together. All checkpoint participants must use matching rules before new shared checkpoint sealing can continue.

recovery.detail: Roll forward to matching app and daemon builds. A rollback must move the apps and daemon together; mixed client literals are not supported.
